'''Adele Konya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was a member of the Corellian cabinet before she joined the Empire as commanding officer in the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Fall of Corellia" /> After General [[Hesker]] was reassigned, she was promoted by [[Darth Marr]] to acting commander and was ultimately the one who gave the order to Imperial forces to withdraw from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name="Fall of Corellia" />

During the main battle in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], Konya fought alongside the [[Coronas]], a criminal gang of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] loyal to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], in the [[Battle for the Black Hole]], which centered around the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery in the [[Labor Valley]]. Eventually, the Coronas betrayed the Sith when the main battle ended, so the battle for the Black Hole became a three-way fight between the Sith, Republic, and Coronas for control of the refinery. During this conflict, Konya was stationed at [[Horizon Outpost]], an outpost controlled by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] on the edge of the facility. Konya received much opposition from the criminal gang (led by Councilor [[Harmon Torvix|Torvix]]) and was forced to hire an Imperial official to take back a site controlled by them.<ref name="Fall of Corellia" /><ref name="[HEROIC 2+] The End of Torvix">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The End of Torvix|The Black Hole}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
General Konya appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', to which she was added in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]] along with the rest of the Black Hole. She serves to introduce Imperial players to the repeatable Daily missions in the Black Hole.<ref name="1.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.2.0/legacy|text=Game Update 1.2: Legacy Patch Notes}}</ref>
